sponsored.t: Authorizes the department of social services to provide certain notice to providers when written authorization has been provided by the provider or person receiving such notice
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of social services to provide certain notice to providers when written authorization has been provided by the provider or person receiving such notice.

sponsored.t: Authorizes distinctive license plates for doctors of osteopathic medicine
sponsored.sum: Authorizes distinctive license plates for doctors of osteopathic medicine.

sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to security officers employed by Albany Memorial Hospital, Samaritan Hospital, and St. Peter's Hospital
sponsored.sum: Grants peace officer status to security officers employed by Albany Memorial Hospital, Samaritan Hospital, and St. Peter's Hospital when acting pursuant to their special duties on the grounds or premises owned, controlled or administered by any such hospital or any of its subsidiaries.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding opioid overdose prevention measures in certain settings
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts, public libraries, BOCES, county vocational education and extension boards, charter schools, and non-public schools to provide and maintain on-site opioid antagonists; requires the department of health to provide such opioid antagonists to such entities upon request.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the retail sale of nitrous oxide and establishes civil penalties for violations; includes nitrous oxide misuse in the health care and wellness education and outreach program
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Nima's law" which prohibits the retail sale of nitrous oxide; establishes civil penalties for violations; includes nitrous oxide misuse in the health care and wellness education and outreach program to expand education on the dangers of nitrous oxide misuse; prohibits the sale of whip cream chargers.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring agencies to report information about FOIL inquiries to the committee on open government
sponsored.sum: Requires all agencies to submit to the committee on open government a log of all freedom of information law requests for each year in which they received or have pending a request for records; requires the committee on open government to publish, on one webpage, all freedom of information law request logs it receives.

sponsored.t: Relates to payments by a pharmacy benefit manager to participating pharmacies
sponsored.sum: Requires a pharmacy benefit manager to pay a participating pharmacy at minimum at the national average drug acquisition cost (NADAC) rate, or at the pharmacy acquisition cost rate if greater or there is not a NADAC rate, plus a professional dispensing fee that is at minimum the professional dispensing fee paid under the state medical assistance program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purchase of firearms, ammunition, and firearm accessories
sponsored.sum: Requires bidders on contracts to purchase firearms, ammunition, and firearm accessories to submit a statement that the bidder is licensed and in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules and regulations relating to the sale, transfer, storage and disposition of firearms, ammunition and firearm accessories.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Mohawk River Basin management act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a Mohawk River Basin district and Mohawk River Basin management program for management of such district to preserve, protect, restore and enhance the environmental quality of the Mohawk River.

sponsored.t: Relates to the administration of reversible progestin-only contraceptive injections
sponsored.sum: Relates to the administration of reversible progestin-only contraceptive injections; provides that no pharmacist shall administer reversible progestin-only contraceptive injections without receiving training satisfactory to the commissioner of education and the commissioner of health.

sponsored.t: Requires merchants to round cash purchases to the nearest five cent denomination in order to reduce the circulation of pennies within New York state
sponsored.sum: Requires merchants to round cash purchases to the nearest five cent denomination in order to encourage the reduction of the circulation of pennies within New York state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the offices and departments that the department of health shall consult with for the traumatic brain injury program
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to consult with the office of addiction services and supports, the office for the prevention of domestic violence, and the department of veterans' services for purposes of administering the traumatic brain injury program and state policies with respect to traumatic brain injuries; adds the commissioner or executive director of such offices or departments to the traumatic brain injury services coordinating council.

sponsored.t: Relates to fully autonomous vehicles
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of fully autonomous vehicles in Albany and Rensselaer counties until July 1, 2028; provides for operation, licensing, insurance, duties following crashes, on-demand autonomous vehicle networks, registration and titles, operation by human drivers, and related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York prediction market regulation act
sponsored.sum: Requires a license from the department of financial services to operate a prediction market; defines "prediction market" as any platform, electronic or physical, that allows participants to place wagers, trades, or financial positions on the outcome of future events, including but not limited to political, economic, weather, or other contingencies, where payouts are tied to event outcomes; provides for standards of conduct and enforcement authority by the department of financial services.

sponsored.t: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; and makes conforming technical changes
sponsored.sum: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; provides additional definitions; provides remedies for violations of the code; makes conforming technical changes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the prohibition on naming buildings after public officials
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a public officer or member of the legislature from have a building or space named after themself while holding public office based on the fact that such person was responsible for securing public funds for the person or entity involved in naming the building or for securing public funds for the person's or entity's cause or agenda.

sponsored.t: Relates to payments in lieu of taxes
sponsored.sum: Relates to payments in lieu of taxes; provides that the tax base growth factor or quantity change factor includes the change in assessed value for each property on the exempt side of the tax rolls under a payment in lieu of tax agreement; allows a local government or school district to elect to include the equivalent taxable value of property subject to a payment in lieu of taxes agreement in the calculation of its quantity change factor.

sponsored.t: Establishes a portable clearance passport program to satisfy certain background checks
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of children and family services to develop a portable clearance passport program to provide a uniform process for conducting background checks for employment at certain participating agencies.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Sgt Henry Johnson
sponsored.sum: Dedicates the bridge located on Interstate 90, designated as Bridge Number 1092839, which crosses over the Hudson River in the cities of Albany and Rensselaer to Sgt Henry Johnson.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the imposition of a charge or deduction from a payment due to a health care provider because such payment is made through electronic or paper means
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the imposition of a charge or deduction from a payment due to a health care provider because such payment is made through electronic or paper means.

sponsored.t: Relates to the requirements for certification for certified interior designers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the educational and examination requirements for certification as a certified interior designer.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of health to facilitate the exchange of data between the state prescription drug program and electronic health records
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health shall promulgate regulations allowing for any electronic health records integration vendor to obtain state approval to facilitate interoperability between the prescription monitoring program registry and certified electronic health records systems that can connect with any national data sharing hub.

sponsored.t: Relates to disclosure of amounts in trust for the perpetual care of cemetery lots
sponsored.sum: Requires biennial disclosure by trustees or executors of amounts in trust for the perpetual care of cemetery lots to a cemetery association.

sponsored.t: Expands collaborative drug therapy management by pharmacists
sponsored.sum: Expands collaborative drug therapy management by pharmacists; makes permanent certain provisions relating to authorizing pharmacists to perform collaborative drug therapy management with physicians in certain settings.

sponsored.t: Relates to prescription drug formulary coverage for interchangeable biologics and biosimilars
sponsored.sum: Relates to prescription drug formulary coverage for interchangeable biologics and biosimilars.

sponsored.t: Expands Medicaid coverage to include pharmacological treatment for hyperhidrosis
sponsored.sum: Expands Medicaid coverage to include pharmacological treatment for hyperhidrosis when such treatment is ordered by a physician, registered physician assistant, or registered nurse practitioner; provides that the provisions shall not take effect unless all necessary approvals under federal law and regulation have been obtained to receive federal financial participation in the costs.

sponsored.t: Relates to excluding taxes from the amount on which credit card transaction fees are based
sponsored.sum: Excludes the amount of state and local taxes and fees from the amount on which an interchange fee is charged for that electronic payment transaction by a credit or debit card network; prohibits a payment card network from altering or manipulating the computation and imposition of interchange fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to capital upgrades to certain residential health care facilities
sponsored.sum: Ensures that publicly-sponsored residential health care facilities and facilities that receive grants under the Statewide Health Care Facility Transformation program are not subject to outdated total project cost caps or excessive project equity requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to adult vaccination reporting requirements
sponsored.sum: Requires that a health care provider who administers an immunization to a person nineteen years of age or older must report such information to the department of health or to the New York city citywide immunization registry unless the person receiving the immunization objects to such reporting.

sponsored.t: Provides for the appointment of a standing committee on conference to resolve differences between similar, but not identical, bills and resolutions
sponsored.sum: Provides for the appointment of a standing committee on conference to resolve differences between similar, but not identical bills and resolutions; provides that such committee may refer bills and resolutions to sub-committees for disposition; provides for appointment of a non-partisan counsel to make referrals to such standing committee on similar bills and resolutions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the criminal enforcement of violations of the state's uniform fire prevention and building code
sponsored.sum: Expands the number of parties subject to enforcement of violations of the state's uniform fire prevention and building code.

sponsored.t: Requires state agencies to make available all public documents in a digital format on their website
sponsored.ls: New York State Printing and Public Documents Law
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies to make available all public documents in a digital format on their website in a manner that allows such documents to be printed; provides that no document required by law to remain confidential shall be deemed a public document.

sponsored.t: Relates to prior year state aid adjustments
sponsored.sum: Requires any state aid owed to a school district from a prior year adjustment be paid as part of the first state aid payment of the following school year following the notification of such payments.

sponsored.t: Requires electronic filing of all lobbying filings
sponsored.sum: Requires electronic filing of all lobbying filings with the commission on ethics and lobbying in government.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program enabling counties to opt-in to allow county jails to operate jail-based competency restoration services for incarcerated individuals deemed unfit for trial due to mental incapacity
sponsored.sum: Establishes a program enabling counties to opt-in to allow county jails to operate jail-based competency restoration services for incarcerated individuals deemed unfit for trial due to mental incapacity.

sponsored.t: Establishes limits upon local government tax levies
sponsored.sum: Establishes limits upon local government tax levies.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory continuing education requirements for coroners and coroner's deputies
sponsored.sum: Requires a minimum of 30 credit hours of mandatory continuing education every three years for coroners and coroner's deputies.

sponsored.t: Provides a rebuttable presumption relating to recertification as a minority and women-owned business enterprise
sponsored.sum: Provides a rebuttable presumption relating to recertification as a minority and women-owned business enterprise if there is no change in the ownership or capital contribution relied upon for certification of the enterprise and no material change in the nature or management of the enterprise from the time of approval of the previous minority and women-owned business enterprise certification.

sponsored.t: Relates to unclaimed winnings and refunds and the remittance of taxes
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Requires a regional off-track betting corporation that is comprised in the capital district to distribute unclaimed winnings and refunds to participating counties comprising the capital district corporation; provides penalties for late distributions; provides for the remittance of pari-mutuel wagering taxes.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of kratom to individuals under the age of twenty-one
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of kratom to individuals under the age of twenty-one; prohibits the sale or dissemination of information recorded during transaction scans; imposes a civil penalty of not more than five hundred dollars for the sale or provision of kratom to any person under the age of twenty-one; repeals certain provisions relating thereto; repeals certain provisions requiring a study on kratom; relates to the effectiveness of a chapter of the laws of 2025 relating to prohibiting the sale of kratom to persons under the age of 21.

sponsored.t: Replaces the term addict with the term person with substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Replaces the term addict with the term person with substance use disorder.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of professional geology
sponsored.sum: Relates to the practice of professional geology.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rate paid by the state to a city for maintenance and repair of highways
sponsored.sum: Increases the rate paid by the state to a city for maintenance and repair of highways by the percentage change in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (CPI-U), New York-Northern New Jersey-Long Island, NY-NJ-CT-PA, as published by the United States department of labor bureau of labor statistics, over the prior five years.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health insurance policies include coverage for services provided by pharmacists related to contraceptives
sponsored.sum: Requires certain health insurance policies include coverage for services provided by pharmacists related to contraceptives.

sponsored.t: Sets fees for gold star family distinctive plates at the same rate as for gold star mothers
sponsored.sum: Sets fees for gold star family distinctive plates at the same rate as for gold star mothers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the removal of actions to certain courts in an adjoining county
sponsored.sum: Allows the removal of criminal actions to a mental health court in an adjoining county and provides for the reversion to the original court of record where the defendant fails to comply with or complete the mental health court program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the age of eligibility for provisional or permanent appointment of certain police officers
sponsored.sum: Increases the age of eligibility for provisional or permanent appointment of certain police officers from thirty-five to forty.

sponsored.t: Relates to interest rates on judgments
sponsored.sum: Relates to interest rates on judgments.

sponsored.t: Establishes the shovel-ready housing program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the shovel-ready housing program under which certain municipalities, at their option, may pre-authorize parcels of property for the construction of housing; establishes a shovel-ready community tax rebate for taxpayers residing in municipalities that opt-in to the shovel-ready housing program; provides for annual apportionment to municipalities that have certified participation in the shovel-ready housing program.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting information regarding step therapy override requests and determinations; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure, in such form as the superintendent shall require, of non-confidential information regarding step therapy override requests and determinations on a website that is readily accessible to the public.

sponsored.t: Expands use of videoconferencing to purely advisory bodies
sponsored.sum: Expands use of videoconferencing to purely advisory bodies.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state preceptor stipend program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state preceptor stipend program to be administered by the office of the professions, under which qualified preceptor clinicians shall receive a $5,000 stipend; provides for such funds to be distributed from the office of the professions account.

sponsored.t: Requires providers to share electronic health records with plans for purposes of improving patient care and reducing administrative delays
sponsored.sum: Requires providers to share electronic health records with plans for purposes of improving patient care and reducing administrative delays.

sponsored.t: Authorizes emergency medical technicians to administer certain vaccines pursuant to non-patient specific orders and under the authority of an emergency medical services director
sponsored.sum: Authorizes emergency medical technicians to administer certain vaccines pursuant to non-patient specific orders and under the authority of an emergency medical services director after receiving appropriate training; authorizes physicians and certified nurse practitioners to prescribe and order a non-patient specific order to an emergency medical technician to administer certain vaccines; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Requires insurers and health plans to grant automatic preauthorization approvals to eligible health care professionals in certain circumstance
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers and health plans to grant automatic preauthorization approvals to eligible health care professionals in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to collaborative prescriptive authority for psychologists
sponsored.sum: Allows a licensed psychologist to apply to the department of education for conditional prescribing certification if the psychologist meets certain requirements; allows the department of education to waive certain requirements for an applying psychologist; provides that a conditional prescribing certification shall be valid for a period of two years.

sponsored.t: Relates to review of projects affecting the availability of maternity services
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to promulgate regulations requiring that the addition of, decertification of, or changes in the method of delivery of perinatal services by a general hospital be subject to an application under article 28 of the public health law that requires review and approval by the council.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic financial disclosures of members and candidates of the legislature and requires creation of electronic version of disclosure statement
sponsored.sum: Relates to electronic financial disclosures of members and candidates of the legislature; requires creation of electronic version of disclosure statement; directs the commission on ethics and lobbying in government shall make available an editable, electronic, readable and searchable version of the annual statement of financial disclosure by January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Authorizes pharmacists to administer injections for contraceptive use
sponsored.sum: Authorizes pharmacists to administer injections for contraceptive use.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of practice of pharmacy
sponsored.sum: Provides for the initiation of treatment for COVID-19, influenza, and pharyngitis resulting from a Group A streptococcal infection by a licensed pharmacist in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of environmental conservation to undertake a review of the regulations governing the permitting of landfills and transfer stations
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation to undertake a review of the regulations governing the permitting of landfills and transfer stations to ensure that such regulations integrate the latest scientific information.

sponsored.t: Establishes a civil remedy for the protection of animals denied proper care
sponsored.sum: Establishes a civil remedy for the protection of animals denied proper care by creating a special proceeding in the supreme court that will hold owners and caretakers liable if such animals under their care are mistreated.

sponsored.t: Relates to professional obligations under the physician loan repayment program
sponsored.sum: Relates to professional obligations under the physician loan repayment program; provides an option to practice as a physician engaged in private practice in an underserved area.

sponsored.t: Relates to contracts for school food services
sponsored.sum: Provides that a board of education or a board of cooperative educational services shall have the authority to award contracts for school food services on the basis of certain scoring criteria.

sponsored.t: Requires legislators and candidates for member of the legislature to provide a link to their financial disclosure statements on their official state and campaign websites
sponsored.sum: Requires legislators and candidates for members of the legislature to provide a link to their financial disclosure statements on their official state and campaign websites which shall direct website visitors to the current financial disclosure form that the legislator has submitted.

sponsored.t: Relates to certification by pharmacists of patients using medical cannabis
sponsored.sum: Relates to the content and procedure for certification by pharmacists of patients using medical cannabis; allows a pharmacist employed by a registered organization and responsible for supervising the dispensing of medical cannabis within a cannabis dispensing facility to recommend and certify patients upon consultation within such dispensing facility.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of criminal sale of a controlled substance upon the grounds of a drug or alcohol treatment center, or alcoholics anonymous or narcotics anonymous meeting
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of criminal sale of a controlled substance upon the grounds of a drug or alcohol treatment center, or alcoholics anonymous or narcotics anonymous meeting; designates such crime as a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Allows a licensed pharmacist to order and administer certain tests
sponsored.sum: Allows a licensed pharmacist to order and administer certain tests.

sponsored.t: Relates to the offense of aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Includes use of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument in the offense of aggravated cruelty to animals.

sponsored.t: Requires that all victim impact statements in New York state be video recorded; requires that the members of the parole board review all relevant victim impact statements prior to the conduct of a parole hearing
sponsored.sum: Allows victim impact statements in New York state be video recorded; requires that the members of the parole board and all presiding commissioners for such hearing review all relevant victim impact statements prior to the conduct of a parole hearing and to sign a written attestation confirming that they have done so.

sponsored.t: Authorizes physicians and pharmacists to enter into collaborative practice medication adherence protocols for their patients
sponsored.sum: Authorizes physicians and pharmacists to enter into collaborative practice medication adherence protocols for their patients; makes permanent certain provisions relating to authorizing pharmacists to perform with physicians in certain settings.

sponsored.t: Relates to transition and inauguration receipts and expenditures
sponsored.sum: Relates to the statements of receipts, contributions, transfers and expenditures to transition and inauguration entities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the period during which the empire state digital gaming tax credit may be claimed, criteria for such tax credit, and allowing a rollover of such credit
sponsored.sum: Extends the period during which the empire state digital gaming tax credit may be claimed to 01/01/2032; amends the eligibility criteria for game development companies by changing the yearly timeframe structure, lowering the dollar threshold per production, and removing the in-state cost incurred threshold to accurately fit current digital gaming industry models; allows unused credits to be rolled over to the following tax year.

sponsored.t: Relates to enhancing patient access to medication assisted treatment for treatment of opioid disease
sponsored.sum: Allows a licensed pharmacist to prescribe and order FDA-approved medication assisted therapy under a non-patient-specific regimen for the treatment of opioid use disease.

sponsored.t: Includes Suvorexant in the Schedule IV list of depressant drugs
sponsored.sum: Includes sleep medication Suvorexant in the Schedule IV list of depressant drugs.

sponsored.t: Requires pharmacies to provide prescription drug readers
sponsored.sum: Requires pharmacies to provide prescription drug readers or other means of access to individuals who disclose they have difficulty seeing or reading standard print labels on prescription drug containers; defines "prescription drug reader" to mean a device which is capable of audibly conveying information contained on the label of a prescription drug; makes exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to mortgage guaranty insurance
sponsored.sum: Relates to mortgage guaranty insurance; allows for withdrawals from the contingency reserve if the superintendent determines that such withdrawals will not be harmful to policy holders.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing net revenues from utility-owned large-scale renewable generation projects to low-income customers and authorizes utility companies to own such projects
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing net revenues from utility-owned large-scale renewable generation projects to low-income customers; authorizes utility companies to own such projects; provides that the commission shall require labor agreements and labor peace agreements.

sponsored.t: Requires certain entities to stock opioid antagonists and to store naloxone nasal sprays with or adjacent to automated external defibrillator cabinets
sponsored.sum: Requires certain entities to stock opioid antagonists and to store naloxone nasal sprays with or adjacent to automated external defibrillator cabinets.

sponsored.t: Ensures identical health benefits for public retirees
sponsored.sum: Ensures that public retirees are not having their skilled nursing care benefits reduced under the state health benefit plan at the time they enroll for medicare.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Capital Region preceptor stipend program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Capital Region preceptor stipend program to be administered by the office of the professions, under which qualified preceptor clinicians shall receive a $5,000 stipend; provides for such funds to be distributed from the office of the professions account.

sponsored.t: Removes the prohibition relating to certain discovery of testimony
sponsored.sum: Removes the prohibition relating to certain discovery of testimony in certain actions for medical, dental or podiatric malpractice.

sponsored.t: Provides for state assistance to local governments for the enforcement of fire prevention and building codes
sponsored.sum: Provides for state assistance to local governments for the enforcement of fire prevention and building codes using monies paid into the code enforcement account.

sponsored.t: Permits unvented attics and unvented enclosed rafter assemblies to be sealed with air-impermeable insulation in order to help attain building decarbonization goals
sponsored.sum: Permits unvented attics and unvented enclosed rafter assemblies to be sealed with air-impermeable insulation in order to help attain building decarbonization goals.

sponsored.t: Relates to lobbying for the confirmation of persons to state office
sponsored.sum: Requires registration and the disclosure of information relating to lobbying for the nomination or confirmation of persons to state office.

sponsored.t: Establishes the vacant rental improvement program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the vacant rental improvement program to provide grants of up to $75,000 per unit to owners of buildings with five or fewer units.

sponsored.t: Relates to watershed mitigation
sponsored.sum: Provides that when approving proposals to enhance the existing benefits provided by a wetland or to create and maintain new wetland benefits in order to increase the likelihood that a proposed activity will meet the applicable standard for permit issuance, the mitigation may occur within the same watershed as the proposed project.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring providers to share electronic medical records with healthcare plans
sponsored.sum: Requires that a contract between an insurer and a hospital shall include a provision that provides for medical records requested by the insurer or its utilization review agent to be made available electronically by the hospital; limits the use of disclosed records.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of private-label liquor at retail for consumption off the premises
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the sale of private-label liquor at retail for consumption off the premises by certain licensed distillers; requires the labels of such private-label liquors to indicate that the distiller is licensed in New York state; requires reporting.

sponsored.t: Postpones the implementation and enforcement of advanced clean cars II regulations
sponsored.sum: Postpones the implementation and enforcement of advanced clean cars II regulations by the department of environmental conservation.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending the exemption of certain chemicals used in mattresses from regulation for an additional year
sponsored.sum: Extends an exemption relating to the use of certain chemicals used in mattresses from regulation for an additional year.

sponsored.t: Extends the waiver of approval and income limitations on to retired law enforcement officers employed as school resource officers in school districts and board of cooperative educational services
sponsored.sum: Extends the waiver of approval and income limitations on to retired law enforcement officers employed as school resource officers in school districts and board of cooperative educational services.

sponsored.t: Categorizes the assault of a code enforcement official or other individual responsible for building inspection as a class D felony
sponsored.sum: Categorizes the assault of a code enforcement official or other individual responsible for building inspection performing their lawful duties under such position as a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Renames an office of addiction services and supports scholarship program the NYS Father Peter Young Memorial Addiction Professionals Scholarship Program
sponsored.sum: Renames an office of addiction services and supports scholarship program the "NYS Father Peter Young Memorial Addiction Professionals Scholarship Program"; codifies the purposes of such program as offering financial education assistance to individuals pursuing a bachelor's degree in addiction studies or the education requirements for an office of addiction services and supports credential at Alfred State College, Stony Brook University or Empire State University.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide additional services to local governments and the department of environmental conservation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide additional services to local governments and the department of environmental conservation.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing blue envelopes to individuals with autism spectrum disorder
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of motor vehicles commissioner to offer, upon request, a "blue envelope" to a person who has autism spectrum disorder in order to facilitate clear and safe communication with law enforcement and provide ease of access to a driver's documentation.

sponsored.t: Relates to funding of state university of New York programs by state agencies
sponsored.sum: Provides that state-funded SUNY programs shall be reimbursed at no less than 26% of the direct costs; allows state agencies to fund SUNY programs where such state agencies determine that such program would produce administrative efficiencies or cost savings.

sponsored.t: Increases the cap on the credit for contributions to certain funds for contributions to the SUNY Impact Foundation to twenty million dollars
sponsored.sum: Increases the cap on the credit for contributions to certain funds for contributions to the SUNY Impact Foundation from ten million dollars to twenty million dollars.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot learner engagement and attendance program in certain school districts of the state
sponsored.sum: Establishes a three-year pilot program to be known as the "learner engagement and attendance program of New York (LEAP-NY)" in certain school districts of the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to preferred source status for entities that provide employment to certain persons
sponsored.sum: Includes entities that provide employment or services to formerly incarcerated persons in the preferred source exemption for purposes of state purchasing.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 122 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 2496, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the state finance law, in relation to preferred source status for entities that provide employment and services to certain persons" NOT APPROVED The bill would expand the group of those eligible to participate in our preferred source program, currently consisting of the Corcraft Products, New York State Preferred Source Program for People who are Blind and the New York State Industries for the Disabled (NYSID), to include those who are formerly incarcerated. The bill further adds "assembled or fulfilled" as the list of accepted tasks for commodities to the State's preferred source program. Although I support the goals and purpose of the preferred source program, the bill poses a series of issues. First, the goal of the preferred…

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory continuing education requirements for coroners and coroner's deputies
sponsored.sum: Requires 30 hours of mandatory continuing education every three years for coroners and coroner's deputies.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 32 Chapter 648 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 4014, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the county law, in relation to mandatory continuing education requirements for coroners and coroner's deputies" APPROVED This bill would require coroners and coroner deputies to complete at least 30 credits in medical-legal investigation courses over a three- year period. I support the goal of this legislation, which will ensure that coron- ers and coroner deputies are consistently gaining the medical-legal knowledge necessary to perform their critical public health functions. To further strengthen the bill, changes were necessary to provide a system for coroners and their deputies to register triennially with their respective county and file an attestation of completion, as well as establish a process to allow each county the authority to temporarily waive the…

sponsored.t: Allows for the donation of personal property of the state to certain not-for-profit organizations
sponsored.sum: Allows for the donation of personal property of the state to certain not-for-profit organizations that are up to date on annual filings.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 65 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 4723, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the state finance law, in relation to allowing for the donation of personal property of the state to certain not-for- profit organizations" NOT APPROVED The bill would allow for the donation of personal property of the state to certain not-for-profit organizations. While I understand the goals of the legislation, the bill raises concerns related to the constitutional prohibition of gifts. Article VII, Section 8 of the New York State Constitution prohibits the State from giving money to corporations and associations. Property of the State being donated would constitute such a gift. The Office of General Services offers an auction program for items that not-for-pro- fits could use in order to attain surplus property at a low cost.…

sponsored.t: Permits records required to be disclosed under the freedom of information law to have exempt parts of such documents be redacted before disclosure
sponsored.sum: Permits records required to be disclosed under the freedom of information law to have exempt parts of such documents be redacted before disclosure.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 69 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 6613, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public officers law, in relation to permitting records required to be disclosed under the freedom of information law to have exempt parts of such documents be redacted before disclosure" NOT APPROVED This bill would require agencies to disclose records that are disclos- able under the Freedom of Information Law while redacting or withholding any portions of such records that are subject to an exception from disclosure. This bill is unnecessary and duplicative of current law, which already permits agencies to withhold records or portions of records that are otherwise exempt from disclosure under FOIL. I am therefore constrained to veto this bill. The bill is disapproved. (signed) KATHY HOCHUL __________

sponsored.t: Relates to the removal of actions to certain courts in an adjoining county
sponsored.sum: Allows the removal of criminal actions to a mental health court in an adjoining county.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 12 Chapter 587 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 7563, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the criminal procedure law, in relation to the removal of actions to certain courts in an adjoining county" APPROVED This bill would allow criminal cases to be transferred from counties that do not have mental health courts to mental health courts in adjoin- ing counties upon the consent of the prosecutor. The law already allows for this type of transfer in cases involving human trafficking and veterans' treatment courts. I support increasing access to mental health courts, which promote public safety by connecting defendants with mental illness to court-su- pervised community-based mental health treatment. However, this bill does not contain sufficient clarity about how such services are to be coordinated across counties when cases are moved to adjoining counties, as…

sponsored.t: Relates to the time of transfer of certain state lands to KIPP: Albany Community Public Charter Schools, and to the effectiveness of certain provisions relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Provides that the transfer of certain state lands to KIPP: Albany Community Public Charter Schools shall be made after the submission of the application to the office of general services for such transfer, and prior to the expiration of provisions authorizing such transfer; extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Designates the state of New York a purple heart state
sponsored.sum: Designates the state of New York a purple heart state.

sponsored.t: Provides parity to durable medical equipment providers by requiring Medicaid managed care organizations to reimburse such providers
sponsored.sum: Provides parity to durable medical equipment providers by requiring Medicaid managed care organizations to reimburse such providers at no less than one hundred percent of the medical assistance durable medical equipment and complex rehabilitation technology fee schedule for the same service or item.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 40 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 2520, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the social services law, in relation to providing parity to durable medical equipment providers by requiring Medi- caid managed care organizations to reimburse such providers at no less than one hundred percent of the medical assistance durable medical equipment and complex rehabilitation technology fee sched- ule for the same service or item" NOT APPROVED This bill would establish a minimum payment through Medicaid Managed care for durable medical equipment (DME), prosthetics, orthotics, and related supplies, by requiring the Medicaid managed care plans pay DME providers at no less than the rate set for use in the Medicaid fee-for- service (FFS) program. If signed into law, this bill would place an additional cost on the Medicaid…

sponsored.t: Relates to hotel and motel taxes in Saratoga county and the city of Saratoga Springs
sponsored.sum: Relates to hotel and motel taxes in Saratoga county and the city of Saratoga Springs; increases the allowable amount of tax imposed by the county; removes exemptions for properties having less than 4 units; relates to the disposition of tax revenues collected; eliminates an advisory committee.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York State Resident Experience Act of 2025"
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies to measure, collect, report, and utilize metrics relating to the experience of residents interacting with agencies to improve provision of services to the people of the state, and to provide a biannual report to the governor and legislature.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 28 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 3273, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to enacting the New York State Resident Experience Act of 2025" NOT APPROVED This bill would require state agencies that provide or fund resident- facing services to collect data from the people they serve to assess and enhance programmatic efficiency and improve resident experience. I believe in the importance of improving New Yorkers' interactions with their government. I have made customer experience a priority by estab- lishing an Office of Customer Experience to develop statewide customer service strategies and pilot projects across state agencies. However, this bill imposes mandates and timelines that would stifle the ability of state agencies to innovate and respond to feedback. I will…

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of article 19-b of the real property actions and proceedings law providing for special proceedings to convey title to abandoned commercial and industrial real property
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of provisions providing for special proceedings to convey title to abandoned commercial and industrial real property to a city, town, or village.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health insurance policies include coverage for services provided by pharmacists related to contraceptives
sponsored.sum: Requires certain health insurance policies include coverage for services provided by pharmacists related to contraceptives.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of kratom to individuals under the age of twenty-one
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of kratom to individuals under the age of twenty-one; imposes a civil penalty of not more than five hundred dollars for the sale or provision of kratom to any person under the age of twenty-one.

sponsored.t: Authorizes practitioners in institutional dispensers to dispense controlled substances as emergency treatment and authorizes practitioners to dispense controlled substances for use in detoxification treatment
sponsored.sum: Authorizes practitioners in institutional dispensers to dispense controlled substances as emergency treatment for use off the premises of the institutional dispenser; authorizes practitioners to dispense controlled substances for use in maintenance or detoxification treatment to an addict or habitual user.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a licensed pharmacist to administer a United States Food and Drug Administration-approved reversible progestin-only contraceptive injection
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a licensed pharmacist to administer a United States Food and Drug Administration-approved reversible progestin-only contraceptive injection.

sponsored.t: Relates to dispensing certain controlled substances for use by a person with a substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Relates to dispensing certain controlled substances for use by a person with a substance use disorder during certain emergency medical treatment, for use in maintenance or detoxification treatment, or to relieve acute withdrawal symptoms.

sponsored.t: Provides a rebuttable presumption relating to recertification as a minority and women-owned business enterprise
sponsored.sum: Provides a rebuttable presumption relating to recertification as a minority and women-owned business enterprise if there is no change in the ownership of the enterprise and no material change in the nature or management of the enterprise from the time of approval of the previous minority and women-owned business enterprise certification.

sponsored.t: Raises the exclusion of certain indebtedness of school districts other than school districts in a city with one hundred twenty-five thousand inhabitants or more
sponsored.sum: Raises the exclusion of certain indebtedness of school districts other than school districts in a city with one hundred twenty-five thousand inhabitants or more according to the latest federal census.

sponsored.t: Relates to public-facing websites operated by political committees
sponsored.sum: Requires public-facing websites operated by political committees to contain "paid for by" language; adds such public-facing websites to the list of political communications that qualify as independent expenditures.

sponsored.t: Relates to step therapy protocol
sponsored.sum: Relates to health care plans for step therapy protocol; amends effective date to January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Amends the effectiveness of provisions related to the submission of physician profile information
sponsored.sum: Amends the effectiveness of provisions related to the submission of physician profile information.

sponsored.t: Establishes when services for traumatic brain injuries granted pursuant to a waiver shall begin
sponsored.sum: Establishes when services for traumatic brain injuries granted pursuant to a waiver shall begin.

sponsored.t: Relates to recommendations of the traumatic brain injury services coordinating council
sponsored.sum: Sets the basis for recommendations of the traumatic brain injury services coordinating council; requires annual posting of such recommendations.

sponsored.t: Relates to information regarding the home energy assistance program for participants in the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program
sponsored.sum: Requires the provision of information regarding the home energy assistance program for participants in the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program.
